item_name: Rothco Thin Blue Line Web Belt
item_short_desc: The Thin Blue Line is a symbol of respect and support for Police and Law Enforcement Officials; show your support with the Rothco's Thin Blue Line Web Belt.
description: Show your support for local police and law enforcement officials with Rothco's Thin Blue Line Web Belt. The military style web belt measures 1 1/4" wide and features a thin blue line down the middle, in honor of our law enforcement. This belt is made from 100% cotton, comes with a black buckle and a transparent protective plastic tip.
